title: My review
body: "I've been using this app for a few weeks now, and I was so impressed with its accuracy and ability to cater to my needs that I upgraded to premium. While the week view at the top of the home screen is helpful, I have a suggestion to make it even better. Instead of having a single ring displaying the overall completion percentage of all habits in a day, it would be fantastic to see multiple colored rings, similar to the Apple Watch's activity rings. Each ring could represent a category, and habits could be categorized accordingly. For example, if I have habits related to health, like working out, drinking water, and sleeping early, I can group them under a 'Health' category represented by a blue ring. This way, when looking back on previous days, I can easily assess my performance in different areas of my life. A single 75% ring doesn't convey the full story; separate rings would show that I'm achieving 100% of my 'Health' habits but only 50% of my 'Work' habits. I truly believe that this enhancement would give users a more comprehensive view of their progress and areas for improvement. Today, I'm enthusiastic to write this review and share my positive experience with the app, along with this valuable suggestion to make it even more user-friendly and motivating."

title: Very Simple - yet can customize to be more complicated.
body:
I’ve been trying to build habits for a while, and have on-again/off-again used so many apps in the App Store — but I think I have found a design/layout & cost that work for me. 

Option to chose between a one-time payment, or you could also opt to subscribe for $5/yr (which is NOTHING compared to what some applications want) is extremely handy and generous. 

I started out on a free-trial and very quickly, during set up of some basic test habits, noticed how smooth the layout is. How easy it is to set numerous reminders for a habit, on specific days, is so wonderful. 

The ONLY option I would like to see is the option to create a “bad” habit, as in one to set up to break, with limits. The numerous reminders means I could remind myself a few times a day, or to a few random days a week, to not do something — but right now I have it set so that if I have a craving for something then I track RESISTING the craving. Rather than just giving myself a limit on how many times I should be doing something...

All-in-all, the layout and build of the app had me purchasing it after barely a day of having it. The trial showed me that this app, 100% is worth the one time payment for the full features.

title: Great app, by a great developer (w/ only 1 tinny warning)
body:
I have had other ones of their app I fully recommend!

You are NOT forced to pay for the full app (which is monthly or 1 time purchase) only little thing is that if u forget to enter u can only go back on the paid version, but just try t out for free & if u start using it a lot why not!? It’s only the cost of a sandwich 😁

But for iPhone I fully 10/10 recommend!!!

DEAR DEVELOPERS:
This should not sway anybody who what’s the app but in the ‘home tab’ (the one with a ‘+’ icon) when I click on Sunday that little black dot under the day still goes to Sat. (Today is March 9th and I am using an up to date iPhone 6s- if ya need to know)

My only warning for developers:
is if you want to sync it with your Mac, the Mac app is not as good for ur minimalist app (& I had to refund it)
